purpose: A live shared household grocery list: the owner signs in once, creates a board, and shares a 6-char code / link; everyone else opens it with no account and adds or checks off items in real time via Firestore snapshots. Flow: home (hero "Start our list" → auth dialog → createBoard → #/b/CODE) or join (paste code → Open) → board view (add box, item list with checkboxes, collapsed "Share with the household" disclosure holding code / copy link / QR / rotate / delete).
structure: Single-page hash-routed PWA, all CSS inline in index.html:26-97 (no external stylesheet), all view markup built in JS. Shell: div.wrap > header.app (icon img, h1 "Grocery List" wrapping a #/ link, span.spacer, a#tipLink.tipbtn.hidden, button#authBtn.btn.small) + main#view[aria-live=polite] (entirely replaced on every render) + footer.colophon. Outside .wrap: dialog#authDlg (h3, p.hint, #googleBtn, p.sub "or", input#emailInput, div.row with #authCancel/#emailBtn, p#emailSent.hint.hidden), dialog#qrDlg (h3, #qrBox > canvas#qrCanvas 300x300, div.row > #qrClose), div#toast[role=status]. Home view (app.js:84-127) injects div.hero (h2/p/button.btn.primary) + section.card "Joining a household list?" (div.row > code input + Open btn) + optional section.card "Your lists" (ul.plain of li > label + Open btn). Board view (app.js:176-267) injects section.card (add row only, no heading) + section.card (h2 "N to get"/"All done", optional p.hint empty state, ul.plain of li[.done] > label > checkbox + text, optional ✕ btn, optional "Clear checked (n)") + details.manage > summary + div.inner (div.sharecode, row of Copy link/QR code, owner-only row of Rotate link/Delete list). No test/ dir; the only tests are data-layer integration at /workspaces/SWS-apps/apps/signup-sheets/test/grocery.test.mjs.
cssClasses: :root — light palette tokens: bg/card/ink/muted/line/accent/accent-ink/chip/focus/neg (index.html:27-30); dark overrides at :31-36
header.app — flex app bar, TAG-COUPLED to <header> (:44)
header.app img — 34x34 rounded app icon, alt="" (:45)
header.app h1 a — home link, color:inherit + no underline (invisible as a link) (:47)
header.app .spacer — flex:1 pusher, not in studio.css (:48)
a.tipbtn — pill tip-jar link, TAG-COUPLED to <a>, ~34px tall (:49)
section.card — white panel, 14px radius/padding, TAG-COUPLED to <section> (:53)
section.card h2 — .8rem uppercase muted eyebrow; also renders the primary status "N to get" (:54)
input[type=text] — ATTRIBUTE-COUPLED: only text inputs styled; email/checkbox get nothing (:55-58)
button — font-family:inherit only; no font-size/line-height reset (:62)
ul.plain — list-style:none, zero margin/padding, TAG-COUPLED to <ul> (:66)
ul.plain li — flex row, 6px gap, bottom hairline (:67)
ul.plain label — flex:1 tap row, 1.05rem, 12px vertical pad, overflow-wrap:anywhere (:69-72)
ul.plain li.done label — muted + line-through, .done set dynamically (:74)
.sharecode — 1.6rem 700 weight, .28em tracking + matching padding-left recentre hack (:76)
.banner — DEAD CSS, chip-filled notice strip, referenced nowhere (:77)
.sub — muted .82rem; used for error copy and dialog "or" (:78)
.hint — muted .8rem; empty state, loading, help text (:79)
details.manage>.inner — attached panel body, DIRECT-CHILD combinator (:84)
#qrBox — hardcoded #fff QR frame, must stay white in dark mode (:88)
#toast — fixed pill, bottom:24px, opacity-only hide, z-index:50 (:89-93)
#view — main region, wholly replaced each render, carries aria-live=polite
#authBtn — header Sign in / Sign out toggle (.btn.small)
#tipLink — tip-jar anchor, unhidden by JS when CONFIG.tipUrl set
#emailInput — type=email, fully inline-styled because input[type=text] misses it
dynamicMarkup:
Everything inside main#view is generated by app.js via the el() helper (app.js:12-26), which maps {class:…} to className, {text:…} to textContent, on* keys to listeners, and everything else to setAttribute. #view is cleared with replaceChildren() on every render AND on every Firestore snapshot (app.js:88, 146, 183) — no diffing, the whole subtree is rebuilt.

Home (app.js:84-127) emits: div.hero > h2 + p (with nested strong) + button.btn.primary "Start our list"; section.card > h2 + div.row > input[type=text][aria-label="List code"] (inline text-transform/letter-spacing/text-align) + button.btn (inline flex:0 0 auto) "Open"; when signed in, section.card > h2 "Your lists" + ul.plain + p.hint "Loading…", then li > label(inline cursor:default) + button.btn.small "Open" per board, or p.hint "No lists yet…".

Board (app.js:176-267) emits: section.card > div.row > input[type=text] (NO class, NO aria-label, placeholder only) + button.btn.primary (inline flex:0 0 auto) "Add"; section.card > h2 (open.length + " to get" | "All done 🎉") + optional p.hint empty state + ul.plain; per item li[class="done"|""] > label > input[type=checkbox] + body text, plus conditional button.btn.small[aria-label="Remove item"] "✕"; owner-only div(inline margin-top:10px) > button.btn.small "Clear checked (n)"; details.manage > summary "Share with the household" + div.inner > div.sharecode + div.row (button.btn.primary "Copy link" + button.btn "QR code") + owner-only div.row(inline margin-top:8px) > button.btn "Rotate link" + button.btn.small(inline color:var(--neg)) "Delete list". Not-found path emits section.card > p.sub + p > a.

JS also mutates: #toast textContent + .show class (app.js:29-33), #tipLink .hidden removal (app.js:326-327), #authBtn textContent (app.js:319), #emailSent .hidden removal (app.js:306), and canvas#qrCanvas pixels via 2D context (app.js:274-281). setGrowthFooter (app.js:75-82) targets #orgLine — which DOES NOT EXIST in this app's index.html (footer.colophon has no inner span), so it silently no-ops on every render; the participant "Made with Grocery List" growth footer never ships. Sibling apps (home-inventory:126, team-parent:167, signup-sheets:164, caregiver-log:163, seating-chart:142) all carry the span.

comfortDefects.issue: The card eyebrow is .8rem (12.8px) uppercase in muted grey — and it is also the app's primary status readout, rendering "5 to get" / "All done". The single most-scanned number on the board is set at the smallest size in the app.
comfortDefects.fix: Split the two roles: keep a --t-micro eyebrow for true labels, but render the item count as a real heading at --t-xl in --ink, not muted uppercase.

comfortDefects.issue: All teaching and empty-state copy is .hint at .8rem (12.8px) muted — the empty list message, "Loading…", "No lists yet", and the auth dialog's key explainer about who needs to sign in.
comfortDefects.fix: Raise .hint to --t-sm (15px) minimum; promote the empty state to a dedicated .empty block at --t-base.

comfortDefects.issue: Error messages render at .sub = .82rem (13.12px) muted — the smallest, lowest-contrast treatment in the app is reserved for the text that tells users something went wrong.
comfortDefects.fix: Error copy at --t-base in --ink with a --neg accent, never in the muted small style.

comfortDefects.issue: #toast is .87rem (13.92px) and is the ONLY channel for every success, error and offline message in the app; it auto-dismisses after 2400ms by default.
comfortDefects.fix: Adopt studio.css #toast (--t-sm, weight 550) and raise the default dwell to ~4s; errors already pass longer values.

comfortDefects.issue: #toast sits at bottom:24px. While the add-item input is focused on a phone the software keyboard covers that zone, so add-failure toasts are invisible at exactly the moment they fire.
comfortDefects.fix: Anchor the toast above the keyboard/safe area, or render add errors inline beneath the add row.

comfortDefects.issue: .btn.small computes to roughly 32px tall (7px+7px padding, .85rem text at UA line-height ~1.2, 2px border) — well under the 44px minimum. It carries the header Sign in button, the per-item ✕, Clear checked, Delete list, and the Open buttons in Your lists.
comfortDefects.fix: Give .btn.small min-height:var(--tap); studio.css currently sets only 36px, so raise it or stop using .small for these controls.

comfortDefects.issue: The per-item ✕ remove button is the smallest target in the app — roughly 30x32px — and sits only 6px from a 48px-tall label row that users tap constantly to check items off.
comfortDefects.fix: Use studio's .btn.icon (44x44) and increase ul.plain li gap to at least --s3.

comfortDefects.issue: a.tipbtn computes to about 34px tall (6px padding, .85rem) — an under-size target in the header, adjacent to the equally small auth button.
comfortDefects.fix: min-height:var(--tap) on .tipbtn, matching the header row.

comfortDefects.issue: .btn sets font-size but never line-height, and `button{}` at :62 only inherits font-family — so buttons fall back to UA line-height ~1.2 and compute to roughly 42px, marginally under 44px rather than the intended comfortable size.
comfortDefects.fix: Set min-height:var(--tap) and line-height:1 on .btn instead of relying on padding math.

comfortDefects.issue: body line-height is 1.45, sitting exactly at the comfort floor, and item labels at 1.05rem inherit it inside a 600px column.
comfortDefects.fix: Move body to --lh-body (1.55); keep 1.2 only for headings and button labels.

comfortDefects.issue: viewport-fit=cover is opted into but no env(safe-area-inset-*) is used anywhere. On notched iPhones the toast at bottom:24px lands inside the home-indicator strip and .wrap's flat 14px side padding is ignored in landscape.
comfortDefects.fix: padding-inline:max(var(--s4), env(safe-area-inset-left)) on .wrap and bottom:calc(var(--s6) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) on #toast — both already correct in studio.css.

comfortDefects.issue: In the owner share row, "Rotate link" is a .btn (~42px) and "Delete list" is a .btn.small (~32px), yet .row>* forces both to equal width — producing two side-by-side buttons of visibly different heights.
comfortDefects.fix: Use the same size class for both and express the destructive one with .btn.danger.

comfortDefects.issue: Two competing primaries on the board: the "Add" button and "Copy link" are both .btn.primary, so the accent fill no longer signals a single next action.
comfortDefects.fix: Keep .btn.primary for Add on the board; demote Copy link to a secondary once the share panel is open, or vice versa.

comfortDefects.issue: --line (#e3e8ee) against --card (#ffffff) is 1.23:1 and against --bg 1.15:1, while the text input's fill (--bg) against the card is about 1.07:1 — so text fields have essentially no perceivable boundary at all in light mode. Dark mode is the same story at 1.32:1.
comfortDefects.fix: Raise the field border to a --line-2 token meeting 3:1 against the card, and give fields a fill that differs from the card surface.

comfortDefects.issue: Centred body copy in the hero, the colophon and the dialog's "or" line — centring multi-line text at 12-13px hurts scan-back on the return sweep.
comfortDefects.fix: Left-align hero paragraph and colophon text; keep centring for single-word separators only.

navigationDefects.issue: The owner's single most important next action — sharing the link — is hidden inside a collapsed <details> at the very bottom of the board. createList() even toasts "List ready — share the link with the household" while the share UI is closed and below the fold.
navigationDefects.where: app.js:246 (details.manage created without the open attribute), toast at app.js:137
navigationDefects.fix: Open the share panel by default when the board has no items yet, or surface Copy link as a persistent header action once the user is the owner.

navigationDefects.issue: The board never renders the list's own title. b.title is fetched and used only as an argument to addEntry — someone opening a shared link sees an unnamed list with no confirmation they landed in the right household.
navigationDefects.where: app.js:176-267 (b.title referenced only at app.js:209 via the board object)
navigationDefects.fix: Render b.title as the board heading above the add row.

navigationDefects.issue: The empty state teaches nothing. "Empty list, full fridge — for now." is charming but gives a first-time visitor no instruction to add an item or share the link, and it is set in 12.8px muted.
navigationDefects.fix: Replace with a studio .empty block: a one-line instruction pointing at the add field plus a Share button for owners.

navigationDefects.issue: No undo anywhere in the app. The ✕ deletes an item permanently with no confirmation dialog at all — unlike Rotate link, Delete list and Sign out, which all use confirm().
navigationDefects.fix: Add an undo affordance in the toast for item deletion and Clear checked, or at minimum a confirm for multi-item destruction.

navigationDefects.issue: "Clear checked (n)" permanently deletes n items in one batch and reports only a toast count — there is no preview of what is about to vanish and no way back.
navigationDefects.fix: Confirm with the count, and offer undo via the toast.

navigationDefects.issue: Nothing ever tells the user their work is saved. Writes are fire-and-forget to Firestore; the only feedback is an error toast when something fails, and the offline case surfaces only as a caught error string.
navigationDefects.fix: Add a persistent sync/offline indicator — the unused .banner class at index.html:77 appears to have been intended for exactly this.

navigationDefects.issue: There is no visible way back to home from a board. The only route is the h1 anchor, which is deliberately styled color:inherit with text-decoration:none, so it does not read as a link.
navigationDefects.fix: Give the header title a visible affordance, or add an explicit back/home control on the board view.

navigationDefects.issue: On a long list the add box is only at the top and the share panel only at the bottom, with no sticky add bar, no back-to-top and no anchors — adding an item at the store means scrolling the full list up.
navigationDefects.where: app.js:212 (add card appended first), app.js:266 (share appended last)
navigationDefects.fix: Sticky add row (studio has .actionbar), or duplicate the add control at the list foot.

navigationDefects.issue: setGrowthFooter is dead code in this app: it looks up #orgLine, which does not exist in grocery-list's markup (the footer is a bare footer.colophon), so the guard returns early on every call. Participants never see the "Made with Grocery List — Start yours" invitation the function exists to produce.
navigationDefects.where: app.js:75-82, called at app.js:85 and app.js:181; footer at index.html:109
navigationDefects.fix: Wrap the colophon text in … as every sibling app does (see home-inventory/index.html:126).

navigationDefects.issue: "Clear checked" is owner-only, so the family member who actually did the shopping and checked off twenty items cannot tidy the list afterwards.
navigationDefects.fix: Either allow link-holders to clear checked items, or explain the restriction in the UI.

navigationDefects.issue: The hero promises "no accounts" in bold, then "Start our list" immediately opens a sign-in dialog. The dialog explains the nuance, but the primary CTA contradicts the headline it sits under.
navigationDefects.fix: Reword the CTA or hero to scope the promise to the people receiving the link.

navigationDefects.issue: "Delete list" is distinguished from the adjacent non-destructive "Rotate link" by text colour alone, and both are equal-width siblings in the same row — a colour-only distinction for the most destructive action in the app.
navigationDefects.fix: Use .btn.danger (border + hover state, not just colour) and separate it from Rotate link with spacing or a divider.

a11yDefects.issue: main#view carries aria-live="polite" while its entire subtree is destroyed and rebuilt via replaceChildren() on every Firestore snapshot. When any household member checks an item off, every other user's screen reader re-announces the whole page — add box, full item list, share panel.
a11yDefects.where: index.html:108; replaceChildren at app.js:88, 146, 183; drawBoard called from watchBoard app.js:157 and watchEntries app.js:171
a11yDefects.fix: Remove aria-live from #view. #toast already has role=status; route transient status there and announce item-count changes via a small dedicated live region.

a11yDefects.issue: Keyboard focus is destroyed on every re-render. app.js has an explicit hack to restore focus to the add input only (guarded by addFocused); focus on the checkbox you just toggled, the ✕, the share summary, the code field or any Open button is silently lost to <body> whenever a snapshot lands.
a11yDefects.where: app.js:183 (v.replaceChildren) vs the add-only workaround at app.js:48, 193-194, 198-201
a11yDefects.fix: Preserve and restore document.activeElement by a stable key across redraws, or diff the list instead of rebuilding it.

a11yDefects.issue: The add-item input — the primary control of the entire app — has no accessible name. It has only a placeholder; no label element, no aria-label, unlike the home code field which does get one.
a11yDefects.where: app.js:189-196 (compare app.js:98 which sets aria-label 'List code')
a11yDefects.fix: Add aria-label="Add an item" (or a visually hidden label) and keep the placeholder as an example only.

a11yDefects.issue: #emailInput has no label and no aria-label — only a placeholder of "you@example.com".
a11yDefects.fix: Add a <label for="emailInput"> or aria-label="Your email address".

a11yDefects.issue: The focus ring is effectively invisible in light mode: --focus #5eead4 against --bg #f6f7f9 computes to 1.38:1 and against --card #ffffff to 1.48:1, far below the 3:1 required for focus indicators. Keyboard users cannot see where they are.
a11yDefects.fix: Use a focus colour meeting 3:1 against both surfaces plus a contrasting halo — studio.css's --focus + --focus-halo box-shadow pattern at design/studio.css:522-531 solves this.

a11yDefects.issue: Dark mode has the inverse failure: --focus #0f766e against --card #1a2129 is 2.97:1 and against the primary button fill #2dd4bf is 2.94:1 — both below 3:1.
a11yDefects.fix: Pick per-scheme focus colours validated against card, canvas and accent fill.

a11yDefects.issue: The focus-visible rule lists only input, button and a — it omits summary, which is a natively focusable control here (the "Share with the household" disclosure), so it falls back to whatever the UA draws.
a11yDefects.fix: Use a bare :focus-visible rule rather than an element allowlist.

a11yDefects.issue: Every remove button in the list carries the identical accessible name "Remove item". On a twenty-item list a screen reader user hears the same string twenty times with no way to tell which item each one destroys.
a11yDefects.fix: Interpolate the item body: aria-label: 'Remove ' + e.body.

a11yDefects.issue: canvas#qrCanvas has no role, no aria-label and no text fallback, and the QR dialog shows no textual URL — so the entire share-by-QR path is empty for a non-visual user. The share code is rendered in .sharecode on the board but not inside the dialog.
a11yDefects.fix: Give the canvas role="img" and an aria-label carrying the share URL, and print the URL as selectable text beneath it.

a11yDefects.issue: Neither dialog is associated with its heading (no aria-labelledby on #authDlg or #qrDlg), and the showDlg fallback degrades to setAttribute('open') — a non-modal dialog with no backdrop, no focus trap and no Escape handling.
a11yDefects.fix: Add aria-labelledby pointing at each h3; if the fallback path is retained, add manual focus trapping and an Escape listener.

a11yDefects.issue: #toast hides by animating opacity to 0 only — it is never set to visibility:hidden or display:none, so the stale message text remains in the accessibility tree indefinitely and can be read long after it visually disappeared.
a11yDefects.fix: Add visibility:hidden to the base rule and visibility:visible to .show, as studio.css does at design/studio.css:500-503.

a11yDefects.issue: UI component boundaries fail non-text contrast: --line against --card is 1.23:1 in light mode and 1.32:1 in dark, and the text field's fill differs from the card by roughly 1.07:1 — the input's edge is not perceivable by the 3:1 threshold.
a11yDefects.fix: Introduce a stronger --line-2 for interactive boundaries and give fields a distinct surface token.

printSupport:
There is no @media print block anywhere — index.html:31 contains the only @media rule in the file (prefers-color-scheme), and grep for "print" across index.html, app.js, data.js, helpers.js and sw.js returns nothing.

Print is NOT a core use case here. The product thesis is explicitly the opposite of paper: the hero reads "The list is always in your pocket" and the whole architecture is live multi-device sync. Nobody buys this app to print.

But it is a plausible secondary use — printing the list for a household member without a phone, or as a fallback at a store with no signal — and today that path is broken in specific ways: (1) the header, Sign in button, tip-jar pill, footer colophon and the #toast pill all print; (2) the add-item row and its Add button print as an empty box; (3) details.manage is collapsed by default, so the share code, Copy link and QR controls print as a bare grey bar with the code hidden; (4) section.card backgrounds and borders are dropped by default UA print settings, so the card grouping vanishes and the list runs together; (5) the ✕ remove buttons print next to every item; (6) native checkboxes often render as empty or filled boxes inconsistently and the .done line-through is the only completion signal; (7) no @page margin, no break-inside:avoid on li, so items split across pages.

Adopting design/studio.css gets most of this free — its print block at design/studio.css:579-608 already hides header.app, footer.colophon, .tipbtn and #toast, forces white surfaces, sets @page margin:14mm, and applies break-inside:avoid to li and .card. The grocery-specific work remaining is small: mark the add-row card and the ✕ buttons .noprint, force details.manage[open] in print (or move the code out of the disclosure), print the board title and share code in a header, and render a real printed checkbox square rather than relying on the form control.
riskyToRestyle: studio.css sets `.row{flex-wrap:wrap}` and `.row > *{flex:1 1 12rem}` (design/studio.css:~/.row), while grocery's .row (index.html:60-61) is nowrap with flex:1. Under the new base the 12rem (192px) basis plus wrapping will drop the "Add" button below the input on narrow phones, breaking the single most-used control. Both the board add row (app.js:212-213) and the home code row (app.js:109) need .row.nowrap.

JS sets inline `style:'flex:0 0 auto'` on the Add and Open buttons (app.js:101, 202). Inline styles beat any stylesheet, so a .row reimplemented as grid — or any change to how children are sized — will fight these. Same for the inline color:var(--neg) on Delete list (app.js:260), which should become .btn.danger, and width:100% on #googleBtn (index.html:115), which should become .btn.block.

Heavily TAG-COUPLED selectors: section.card, ul.plain, ul.plain li, ul.plain label, ul.plain input[type=checkbox], ul.plain li.done label, details.manage>summary, details.manage>.inner, a.tipbtn, footer.colophon, header.app. Changing any element's tag — section→div, ul→div, a→button — silently drops all styling. The el() calls in app.js hardcode these tags (app.js:107, 112, 121, 212, 215, 217, 246).

`input[type=text]` (index.html:55) is an attribute selector, so #emailInput (type=email, index.html:117) receives NOTHING from the stylesheet and is fully hand-styled inline with duplicated padding/border/radius/background. Restyling the text-input rule will leave the email field visually orphaned unless its inline style block is removed and the selector broadened.

QR generation does exact pixel math against a fixed 300x300 canvas: `cell = Math.floor(size/(count+8))` and `off = Math.floor((size - cell*count)/2)` (app.js:274-276) with size hardcoded to 300 while the canvas element declares width/height 300 (index.html:127). Changing the canvas attributes, or CSS-scaling the canvas without matching the backing store, produces a blurred or mis-registered code that scanners may reject.

#qrBox is hardcoded background:#fff (index.html:88) and the canvas paints its own white quiet zone. This must survive dark mode — a themed surface behind or under the QR breaks scanning. Do not tokenise this one.

.sharecode (index.html:76) uses letter-spacing:.28em plus a compensating padding-left:.28em to re-centre the trailing letter gap. Changing the font, the tracking, or switching to a flex/gap treatment breaks the optical centring of the share code.

sw.js precaches './index.html' under VERSION 'grocery-v4' (sw.js:2-8) with a cache-first fetch handler (sw.js:20-26). Because studio.css is inlined into index.html rather than linked, the new design ships inside index.html — so returning PWA users will keep the OLD inline CSS until VERSION is bumped. Bump to grocery-v5 as part of the restyle or the overhaul appears not to have deployed.

.hidden uses display:none !important (index.html:96) and is load-bearing for #tipLink (app.js:326-327) and #emailSent (app.js:306), both toggled via classList. Keep the !important — studio.css retains .hidden, but verify it wins over any new display rules on .tipbtn.

#view is rebuilt with replaceChildren() on every Firestore snapshot (app.js:183), which fires whenever any household member changes anything. Any entrance transition, animation or transform added to .card, ul.plain li or .btn will re-trigger continuously during normal use, and the addFocused hack (app.js:48, 198-201) is the ONLY thing preserving focus — a restyle that introduces animated mount states will make the board visibly thrash.

Tests are safe: grocery-list has no test/ directory, and the only coverage — /workspaces/SWS-apps/apps/signup-sheets/test/grocery.test.mjs — drives data.js against the emulators and asserts nothing about DOM structure, class names or markup. Nothing in the test suite constrains the restyle.
